decisions.decision: Signup stays open to anyone with a Google account
decisions.rationale: User wants a real multi-tenant product, not a personal page. This is what makes the SEC-* phase mandatory rather than optional.

decisions.rationale: /api/upload takes writes from anyone on the internet with no session check, size limit, or MIME check — a live AWS bill risk on a personal account.
